regions.region: Scheme 2 upper panel, five arrows from 3bf

regions.region: Scheme 2 lower panel, arrows from 3am and E-3an
regions.finding: Two independent derivatization experiments were visually transcribed: Sc(OTf)3-catalyzed cycloaddition to cis-19 and NaOEt/DMSO directing-group removal to E-20. The cis/E labels are retained without inventing absolute descriptors or numerical ratios.

The prose repeats the cis-19 experiment (55% yield) and the E-20 experiment (produced without isomerization). These are duplicate mentions of the two Scheme 2 arrows and were merged as additional evidence, not counted as extra experiments.
